open_points.subject: M29 owner-form-table consumer boundary
open_points.text: The generated code reads the table, so a constant of the data provider delivers it
open_points.question: Which logical consumer module or modules must read the data provider’s owner form table, and may each rely on it for rendering field names, reading submitted fields, or both?
options: One owner-interface module imports the table and uses it for both form generation and request reading.
Separate form-rendering and request-reading modules each import the same provider constant.
A single adapter imports the table and exposes separate rendering and reading operations to the other modules.
open_points.default_guess: One owner-interface module directly imports the table and uses it for both rendering and reading, keeping the direct dependency graph minimal.

witness.initial: The release contains an M29 row for an owner form field, including its field name, destination and text-reading rule.
events: The owner-interface page generator renders the field.
The request reader decides which submitted field to read and where to place its value.
outcomes: One declared consumer uses the provider table for both steps, so the rendered and read names necessarily agree.
Different generated consumers are inferred; one imports the table while the other duplicates or derives the field name, producing a different module dependency and permitting the names to diverge.
witness.observer: The owner sees a submitted value accepted in one implementation but ignored or reported missing in the other; the projector also sees different module_internal graphs.

open_points.subject: M29 owner-form-table constant identifier
open_points.text: a constant of the data provider delivers it
open_points.question: What exact exported constant symbol represents the owner form table so State 6 can place the same symbol in the provider export surface, its owning module and every direct consumer import surface?
options: Choose another explicit uppercase constant name and use it consistently in module_functions, imports.internal and module_internal.
consequences: OWNER_FORM_FIELDS preserves the former name and describes the rows as field definitions.
OWNER_FORM_TABLE follows the current prose but changes the previously used import symbol.
Another name is valid only if every export, ownership and consumer-import declaration adopts it consistently.
open_points.requirement: The generated code reads the table, so a constant of the data provider delivers it (SPEC_STANDARD §15.3.1), as it delivers the seven tables of M22–M28; a `models` catalog of the same table would not reach the code, and none is declared.
